requests.title: Leave Requests
requests.subtitle: Review employee leave applications and approve or reject them.

types.title: Leave Types
types.subtitle: Configure the leave categories employees can apply for. Only active types are visible to employees.

form.name: Leave Type Name
form.assignToAllHint: All active employees will get this leave type for {{year}}.

deactivateModal.title: Deactivate Leave Type?
deactivateModal.body: {{name}} will be hidden from employees and they will not be able to apply for it. Existing balances and history are kept, and everything reappears when you activate it again.

notice.assignFailed_one: {{label}}: {{count}} assignment failed. Use "Assign to All" to retry.
notice.assignFailed_other: {{label}}: {{count}} assignments failed. Use "Assign to All" to retry.
notice.alreadyAssigned_one: {{label}} is already assigned to all {{count}} employee.
notice.alreadyAssigned_other: {{label}} is already assigned to all {{count}} employees.
notice.activated: {{name}} activated. Employees can now see it.
notice.deactivated: {{name}} deactivated. It is now hidden from employees.

balances.title: Leave Balances
balances.subtitle: Set yearly leave days for every type and track how much each employee has used.
balances.noTypesBody: Create leave types in the Leave Types tab first.

addModal.title: Add Leave Balance for One Employee
addModal.hint: Use this only for a single employee, for example a new joiner. To set up everyone together, use Assign to All Employees. The days come from the leave type's yearly quota.

assign.title: Set Up Leave Balances for All Employees
assign.steps: Step 1: Choose the year. Step 2: Tick the leave types and set the days per year for each. Step 3: Click Assign.
assign.note: Every active employee gets these balances. Employees who already have one are skipped, so it is safe to run again.
assign.noActive: There are no active leave types. Create or activate one in the Leave Types tab first.
assign.updateExistingHint: Employees who already have a balance will be changed to the days above. Days already used are kept.
assign.done_one: Done. {{count}} employee now has their leave balances.
assign.done_other: Done. {{count}} employees now have their leave balances.
assign.retryHint: Run it again and only the missing ones will be processed.
